rationale.conceptual: The paper introduces a Symmetry-Constrained Adaptive Basis (SCAB) and a tight-binding model that involves complex transformations, Slater-Koster hopping integrals, and sublattice-dependent crystal fields. Reproducing this requires understanding the derivation, correctly implementing the rotation matrix and hopping matrices, and handling the symmetry-constrained orbital ordering, all of which constitute a non-trivial custom method with multiple interacting components.
rationale.execution: The pipeline consists of three sequential steps (basis construction, Hamiltonian setup, diagonalization along a k-path) with no external tooling beyond numpy/scipy. The I/O is straightforward (CSV output), and there are no complex dependencies or environment issues.
